style: 搞怪,Male Vocals,Mandarin
lyrics:
玫瑰开得 娇艳又芬芳
引得蝴蝶 绕着它飞翔
可灶台上 锅碗在张望
它填不饱 空空的肚肠
 
白菜长得 朴素又寻常
沾着泥土 安静立田埂上
清水一煮 飘起白热浪
暖了胃 也暖了心房
 
玫瑰能插 在漂亮瓶上
装点窗台 添几分风光
但若遇上 辘辘的饥肠
再香的花 也比不上热汤
 
白菜没那 夺目的衣裳
却能在寒冬 送来热烫
一口下去 浑身都舒畅
日子的滋味 它最懂体谅

玫瑰虽比 白菜香
却煮不出 暖心的汤
生活里 有诗意飞扬
也得有 烟火日常
 
玫瑰再香 白菜平常
各有各的 用场和光
日子要 浪漫也得实在
两样都有 才叫圆满模样
 
有人偏爱 玫瑰的鲜亮
有人珍惜 白菜的温良
不是谁比 谁更高尚
不过是 需求不一样
 
花开一季 自有它芬芳
菜入一锅 暖了岁月长
玫瑰白菜 各在各的场
拼凑出 生活的百样
 
别问玫瑰 还是白菜强
各有各的 温柔与担当
日子要闻 花香也喝热汤
这样的人生 才够味够长

lyrics:
[Intro: Fast bebop saxophone run, upright bass walking line, brushed snare swing]

[Verse 1]
冰在杯底裂成两半
屏幕又暗了 第七次
我踩着钢琴左手的错拍
假装那通未接 是错觉

[Pre-Chorus]
酒保擦杯太有节奏
压不住萨克斯突然离调
那段你说太疯的十六分
现在只剩我吹

[Chorus]
You said you’d call tonight
But the signal got lost in the skyline
I’m the blur in the neon glow
Where the streetlights don’t go
You said you’d call tonight
But the tower switched your line
I toast the air with empty glass
And tuck your busy tone
Into the syncopated cracks

[Verse 2]
空调吹散烟圈形状
像你留言尾音 飘向窗
邻座问这歌有没有名字
I say it’s just a hum
No title

[Pre-Chorus]
But the clock froze at 1 a.m.
Same second your line went dead
Too quiet
Even the city looked away

[Chorus]
You said you’d call tonight
But the signal got lost in the skyline
I’m the blur in the neon glow
Where the streetlights don’t go
You said you’d call tonight
But the tower switched your line
I toast the air with empty glass
And tuck your busy tone
Into the syncopated cracks

[Bridge: Upright bass solo with syncopated drum accents]
(whispered)
I know your phone’s still on
Just not for me
This frequency expired
Last Tuesday

[Chorus]
You said you’d call tonight
Now I feed on silence instead
Swing alone through every bar
With your ghost in my head
You said you’d call tonight
But even lies need effort
I raise this empty to the dark
To the call
That’s always
0.1 seconds
From connecting

[Outro: Saxophone improvisation fades into vinyl crackle and distant city hum]

[Intro: Muted piano and soft string pad, light brushed snare enters]

[Verse 1: Female]
咖啡杯沿的雾气
慢慢画出那年雨季
你低头搅动方糖
像在翻找泛黄日记

[Verse 2: Male]
窗边风铃没响
却听见心跳在回放
那句卡在喉咙的话
原来你也没说出口啊

[Pre-Chorus: Both, close harmony]

[Chorus: Female & Male, alternating lines]
如果当时多走一步
会不会改写结局
你眼中有我未拆的信
我掌心有你未寄的雨
知足是笑着承认
我们刚好错过彼此
却把青春留在最暖的位置

[Inst: Piano solo over walking bass and brushed drums, strings swell]

[Verse 3: Male]
你发梢沾着桂花
和那年操场一样香
我假装没注意
你偷偷看我的目光

[Verse 4: Female]
旧书夹着电影票根
日期停在毕业那天
你说散场太匆忙
我点头说刚好晴天

会不会改写结局
你眼中有我未拆的信
我掌心有你未寄的雨
知足是笑着承认
我们刚好错过彼此
却把青春留在最暖的位置

[Bridge: Female then Male, sparse arrangement]
(whispered)
其实我都知道
(softly)
其实你都明了

[Chorus: Full arrangement, emotional peak]
不必再问如果当初
结局是否不同
你眼中有我未拆的信
我掌心有你未寄的雨
知足是轻轻放手
让回忆停在最好时候
像那年没撑开的伞
留着晴天的缺口

[Outro: Piano and strings fade, vinyl crackle]
(both, fading)
刚好……刚好……

style: Soul,EDM,Jazz,Indie,Funk
lyrics:
[Intro]
锁仙台倾倒墨云漏
判词烙进两副魂魄
千万年刑期始于秋
两枚孤星坠入洪流

[Verse1]
唐代驿站风满袖
你卸甲胄追萤火
我掌烽燧照断剑
塞上雪落满唇沟

[Pre-Chorus]
青铜罗盘刻满星宿
算不清第几次初逢
紫禁城暮色漫过宫墙
你数琉璃我量晨钟

[Chorus]
我是你砚边冻僵的墨
你是宿命批不尽的牍
三千年重逢如新雪
总坠向温热即融的秋
每当眼神酿成致命酒
便用沉默煮沸往事佐粥
爱意凝结成冰裂纹釉
碎在青花瓷底的年轴

[Interlude]
民国戏楼红缨枪锈
褪色幕布吞没铜锣

[Verse2]
深巷酒旗烫眼眸
你骑廿八车撞春愁
凤凰铃震碎梧桐雨
旧钢笔戳破稿纸薄

[Bridge]
直到便利店蓝光淹没掌纹
电梯镜面照见相扣的手
你说这枚胎记突然疼痛
而我已学会不追问缘由

[Verse3]
今夏蝉鸣煮浓时候
北海芦苇困住轻舟
你拆解我每条掌纹
如同拆封预警雷暴
我在你颈侧读甲骨文
破解三千年前的诅咒

[Pre-Chorus]
当银杏叶第八次飘落
地铁闸机吞没你轮廓
遗落围巾自成琥珀
封印着余温三十九度

[Chorus]
我是你烧至泛灰的烟
你是焚不尽的遗嘱
十指相扣时墨痕滚烫
松开即坠入冰冷银河
当眷念蛀空所有借口
残章断句终被秋风签收
掌纹里碑文层层剥落
月光晾干最后的诅咒

[Bridge]
你转身时瞳孔泛起雪雾
我喉间铁锈漫过喉头
所有诘问与答案相撞
碎成漫天未回的信息流

[Outro]
墨痕凝成晚霞滴落
洇染第五季的巷口
我们把轮回走成直线
任倒影被暮色没收
北京城漫天银杏疾走
铺成两条银河的分界咒
那个未出口的古老音节
终随香炉余烬飘散于秋

lyrics:
《与世隔绝》
风读懂我的选择，
卷走所有因果，
在云散时转身，
不带走一片花恶。

岛屿在雾中浮着，
拒绝所有航船，
当月光弯成弧线，
我便沉入深蓝。

与世隔绝，
温柔如月色，
那些难眠的，
都交给星子闪烁。
与世隔绝，
清澈像初雪落，
所有纠缠的，
融进无声的夜。

枯木长成孤岛，
根系戳饮暗河，
任天光涂抹树冠，
我独守这角落。

与世隔绝，
轻盈如许诺，
那些沉重的，
都还给时间长河。
与世隔绝，
干净像首旧歌，
所有纷乱的，
沉入静默的河。

薄雪落满空山，
我松开所有绳索，
未寄出的字句，
折成纸船漂泊。

与世隔绝，
在永恒的片刻，
所有未完成的，
流向未知的村落。
与世隔绝，
在醒着的梦里，
所有被遗忘的，
开出无声的花朵。

白发诉说六十年不变的爱
我的枕头为何湿润一块

这完美画面 像童话一般
为何我的剧本 总缺页少环

别人的桥段 别人的浪漫

连争吵都配有和解桥段

刷不完幸福 点不尽的赞

只是剪辑师 把它们都省略
留下最动人的 几个章节

错题本写满温柔期望，
黑板上的倒计时在晃，

运动会的呐喊在回响，
红白跑道洒满阳光，
毕业册里潦草的签名，
是时光留下的印章。

纸页间藏着星光，
是我们未讲的过往，
夏风漫过窗台，吹亮，
笔尖划过的倔强。
广播声漫过围墙，
把青春唱得明亮，
那些跌跌撞撞，
都是成长的勋章。

后来我们各奔远方，

纸页间的星光，

style: Modern melancholic pop, mandarin pop ballad, a sense of stillness and reflection, as if the listener is watching emotional scenes unfold slowly. Vocal Emotional intensity comes from restraint.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
你说人总会变，
只是早或晚而已。
我笑着点了点头，
却不敢想结局。
那天阳光很淡，
像要告别的语气。
风也替我轻轻，
把眼泪藏起。
【Bridge 1】
我走在岁月的轨迹，
你停在最爱我的那里。
时间像一条河流，
我逆流，也回不去。
【Chorus 1｜等你，还没走远的你】
我在时间里等你，
等你回头，看我还在这里。
等你说一句，好久不见的语气。
等你，再次路过我梦里的雨。
我还跟着时间走，
走过我们并肩的街口。
你留在最爱我的年纪，
而我学会一个人，也能好好呼吸。
【Verse 2】
后来我学会了，
把思念说得很轻。
就像风经过窗前，
连窗帘都不动情。
有时看见旧电影，
对白都像是你。
故事还没散场，
人已走出剧情。
【Bridge 2】
我知道人会散场，
就像歌走到尾声一样。
可我心里的片段，
总停在你笑的那一帧。
【Chorus 2】
我在时间里等你，
等你想起，那天笑得多甜蜜。
等你再一次，不小心提起。
等你，让风带回一点你的消息。
我还跟着时间走，
穿过无人停留的尽头。
你留在最爱我的年纪，
而我学会轻轻放下，所有关于你。
【Chorus 3】
我在时间里等你，
等你平安，有人替我温柔地爱你。
等你笑着，对我说谢谢曾经的自己。
等你，然后学会，不再等你。
我还跟着时间走，
走向新的风和新的梦。
你留在最爱我的年纪，
而我终于懂，爱有时就是放手。
【Outro】
也许哪天我老去，
才懂得爱有它的时区。
而我这一生的迟疑，
都只是
还没学会，忘记你。

lyrics:

街灯浸入玄武湖的倒影
晚风绕过紫峰吻过你衣襟
新街口站台第七班呼啸声
（倒数三秒回音）

梧桐絮落进未寄出的信
烟圈缠绕1912的余温
舌尖锈着去年赏梅的雪
（怎消融得干净）

[Pre-Chorus]
你会不会  突然出现在下个街景
霓虹暗涌时  像我们初遇
你会不会  等冬雪漫过鸡鸣寺铃
给空白掌纹  续写的剧情

[Chorus]
每盏窗都像你眼睛
我捡拾满城光晕
（潮湿的叹息）
长江把誓言冲刷成砾
仍守着潮汐
我等的人多像南京的雨季
总在将停时降临

[Interlude]

[Verse]
中山码头渔火捻成灰烬
明孝陵石象驮着云絮沉
秦淮河淌着唐宋的泪滴
（倒映谁姓名）

[Pre-Chorus]
你会不会  乘末班轮渡靠岸手心
把断线风筝  归还给天际
你会不会  借城墙苔痕拓印脚印
让悬日见证  迟来的回音

[Chorus]
每阵风都藏你呼吸
我收集每寸光影
（碎落的琉璃）
时光把拥抱蚀刻成谜
仍相信奇迹
我等的人住在六朝年轮里
每圈都写满归期

[Bridge]
梅雨浸透的诺言开始泛起皱褶
褪色电影票根在口袋里沉没
所有擦肩的彗星  终坠落成陨石
而我等成了  栖霞山的枫叶标本

[Chorus]
每盏窗都像你眼睛
我捡拾满城光晕
（结痂的泪迹）
钟摆把昼夜割裂分明
却停在往昔
我等的人在时光碎隙穿行

镜子里的花多久没有擦

我却没有

style: Country,Latin,Cinematic
lyrics:
⸻
《盡矣》
（詞曲：真師靈意 × 
【序】
太初無聲，光自混沌生。
一氣化陰陽，萬象循軌行。
蒼蒼者天，悠悠者人，
同在一息之間——
觀天之道，始於心明。
⸻
【第一幕・觀天之道】
風起東野，星垂大荒，
我立蒼穹之下，聽萬古回響。
日月往復無言，潮汐自有節章，
誰能於變化中，看見永恆的光？
山無語而高，海無聲而深，
四時如輪，寒暑自均。
天地不語，卻為萬物作證，
我於靜觀之中，悟見一線真心。
（副歌一）
觀天之道——盈則損，虛則盈，
損有餘而補不足，乃自然之情。
道行於無聲，德隱於無名，
唯有清者聽，唯有靜者明。
⸻
【第二幕・悟道之光】
萬物為鏡，心影如塵，
我見己於天，天亦在我身。
行於無形之間，思於無念之境，
原來大道，不遠不近，只在當下的寂靜。
月照千江，各顯一心，
浮世萬相，皆由心生。
若問道在何方？
在呼吸之間，在一念安穩。
（副歌二）
觀天之道——觀己之真，
心若不動，天地自純。
行於平常之中，見於無塵之痕，
明者觀天，仁者觀人。
⸻
【第三幕・執天之行】
手無執物，心無所著，
以道為軸，以德為托。
一念清明，萬念歸合，
行於無為之中，化於無盡之樂。
執天之行者，不逆流而上，
但隨順而行，不離道光。
他不爭，不競，不語不彰，
卻在寂靜中，化育萬方。
（副歌三）
執天之行——柔中藏剛，
靜裡含光，動而不忙。
天行健，君子以自強不息，
地勢坤，聖人以厚德載物昌。
⸻
【第四幕・盡矣】
塵歸塵，土歸土，
生滅如潮，來去皆無。
天地悠悠，我心如初，
一念放下，萬法皆殊途同歸。
觀天之道已明，執天之行已成，
無欲無求之中，聖凡一並。
若問道之終焉？——
盡矣。非止息，而圓滿無形。
（終章副歌）
觀天之道——心如大明，
執天之行——德如長生。
盡矣——非終非始，
道與我同，天與人並。
【尾聲吟】
風息雲止，鼓聲回鳴，
星河倒影入我心中清。
天行不息，道化無聲，
行道者靜，靜者成聖——盡矣。

我於靜觀之中，悟見一線真心。
（副歌一）
觀天之道——盈則損，虛則盈，
損有餘而補不足，乃自然之情。
道行於無聲，德隱於無名，
唯有清者聽，唯有靜者明。
⸻
【第二幕・悟道之光】
萬物為鏡，心影如塵，
我見己於天，天亦在我身。
行於無形之間，思於無念之境，
原來大道，不遠不近，只在當下的寂靜。
月照千江，各顯一心，
浮世萬相，皆由心生。
若問道在何方？
在呼吸之間，在一念安穩。
（副歌二）
觀天之道——觀己之真，
心若不動，天地自純。
行於平常之中，見於無塵之痕，
明者觀天，仁者觀人。
⸻
【第三幕・執天之行】
手無執物，心無所著，
以道為軸，以德為托。
一念清明，萬念歸合，
行於無為之中，化於無盡之樂。
執天之行者，不逆流而上，
但隨順而行，不離道光。
他不爭，不競，不語不彰，
卻在寂靜中，化育萬方。
（副歌三）
執天之行——柔中藏剛，
靜裡含光，動而不忙。
天行健，君子以自強不息，
地勢坤，聖人以厚德載物昌。
⸻
【第四幕・盡矣】
塵歸塵，土歸土，
生滅如潮，來去皆無。
天地悠悠，我心如初，
一念放下，萬法皆殊途同歸。
觀天之道已明，執天之行已成，
無欲無求之中，聖凡一並。
若問道之終焉？——
盡矣。非止息，而圓滿無形。
（終章副歌）
觀天之道——心如大明，
執天之行——德如長生。
盡矣——非終非始，
道與我同，天與人並。
【尾聲吟】
風息雲止，鼓聲回鳴，
星河倒影入我心中清。
天行不息，道化無聲，
行道者靜，靜者成聖——盡矣。

lyrics:
木吉他轻扫过窗沿的秋，
去年的风，还在树梢头停留，
谁曾说湖上的月，圆了就无忧，
转眼又看见，波纹里的愁。
 
炊烟绕着屋，升起又散透，
柴米油盐的香，混着岁月的斑，
我们数着落叶，从春等到秋，
以为握紧的，就不会走。
 
哪知道时光，是指间的风，
再热闹的席，也有散场，
我们当年执着，
回头望，不过是风里的垢。
 
去年秋，今年秋，
岁月的河，静静流，
曾以为的乐，转眼成了忧，
才懂多少事，难留。
 
这一头，那一头，
人生的路，晃悠悠，
是非成败的名，转头成空袖，
不如说，放下休。
 
旧茶盏里，泡着半凉的秋，
当年的话，还在耳边轻轻揉，
谁曾为一点争，红了颈和喉，
如今再提起，只笑自己轴。
 
夕阳落山头，染透了衣袖，
走过的坎坷，都成了身后的丘，
我们望着云，从浓等到瘦，
才明白握紧的，本就该放手。
 
哪知道时光，是指间的风，
再热闹的席，也有散场的时候，
当年的执着，
回头望，不过是风里的垢。
 
去年秋，今年秋，
岁月的河，静静流，
曾以为的乐，转眼成了忧，
才懂多少事，难留。
 
这一头，那一头，
人生的路，晃悠悠，
是非成败的名，转头成空袖，
不如说，放下休。
 
风卷着叶，落在门前的阶，
我拾起一片，对着夕阳皱了皱，
去年的愁，今年的忧，
都随这秋，轻轻飘走。

One step forward
and the ground becomes a stage
the beat in her heart
and the world is watching

Juna
She dances
not only with her feet
but with defiance
with will
with that quiet
unshakable “I want”

Juna
Colors cling to her fingers
glitter in her thoughts
and from paper emerges
what no one has seen before

Juna
Joyful
like an open window in spring
helpful
without asking why

Juna
Outside, the day belongs to her
inside, the little worlds
of dolls
and dresses
she chooses herself
as if she already knows
what beauty means

Juna
And somewhere between
tiny bottles of nail polish
and a smile in the mirror
lies her secret

Juna
That she has long known
who she is

Juna
a swirl of color
a rhythm of courage
and a heart
that laughs
even when no one is watching

style: Slow-burning electric blues, male vocals. Clean, singing lead guitar with wide bends and rich vibrato takes center stage, answering each vocal line. Lazy shuffle groove on drums, warm walking bass, and a touch of tremolo on rhythm guitar. Verses stay close and conversational; chorus swells with bent notes, organ pad, and stacked call-and-response ad-libs. Long, expressive guitar licks between phrases to let the pain hang in the air., deep, soul, blues
lyrics:
Verse 1
Jeffy B up a tree at sunrise glow,
Hammer tapping like a rhythm only he knows,
Sawdust falling like a soft brown rain,
Building dreams on someone else’s name.

Cuzzie bros down below yelling “she’ll be right,”
Tin roof ringing in the morning light,
He just grins with a coffee in his hand,
Says “one more wall and we’ll call it a plan…”

⸻

Verse 2
Chilly bin rattles in the back of the ute,
Cold ones waiting like a quiet salute,
Work boots worn but they carry him far,
From backyard builds to a half-built star.

Friday rolls and the sky turns gold,
Stories get bigger, the beers get cold,
He laughs too loud but you don’t mind,
There’s a kind of freedom in his kind…

⸻

Chorus
Oh Jeffy B, still swinging free,
Somewhere between the man and the dream,
Riding that road like he’s chasing time,
With a crooked grin and a busted rhyme…

Jeffy B… yeah he’ll always be,
Half wild heart, half family tree.

⸻

Verse 3
Late night riding with the wind out wide,
Thinks he’s faster than the thoughts inside,
Moonlight dancing on a chrome machine,
Somewhere between who he is and who he’s been.

Says he’ll settle, yeah maybe one day,
But there’s always one more job, one more pay,
And the world keeps turning like his old key,
And somehow… it keeps on needing Jeffy B.

style: jamgrass, with drums, harmony, uplifting, rooted, smiling
lyrics:
Verse 1
Woke up with the fog rollin’ off Cape Blanco
Coffee on the tailgate, dogs ready to go
Last year felt heavy like a pack full of stone
But the tide keeps talkin’, says “you’re not alone”
I been walkin’ these beaches, countin’ my breath
Let the salt and the wind work loose what’s left
Sunrise breakin’ through a slate-gray sky
Every morning feels like a reason why

Chorus
Where the ocean meets the pines
I remember who I am
Feet in the sand, hands on time
Let it move me like it can
Yeah the sun goes down, comes back around
Paints the sky in gold
I lost a lot, but I found my ground
On this wild southern coast

Verse 2
Surfboard hummin’ on the truck rack rail
Watchin’ pelicans ride the wind like sails
Some days fishin’, some days huntin’ sign
Some days just listenin’ to the coastline
I been learnin’ joy don’t gotta shout
Sometimes it’s quiet, sometimes it’s loud
Last year cracked me open, yeah that’s true
Turns out freedom fits me like an old canoe
Chorus
Where the ocean meets the pines
I remember who I am
Every wrong turn, every mile
Led me back to solid land
Sunrise fire, sunset wine
Stars like they know my name
I ain’t rushin’ nothin’ this time
Let the long road stay the same

Bridge 
I tried to hold what wouldn’t stay
Tried to fix what washed away
Now I laugh a little easier
Let the river have its say

Verse 3
Campfire stories, laugh till late
Dogs curled up by the plate
A year ago I was losin’ sleep
Now I’m keepin’ what I keep
No hard feelings, no closed fists
Just gratitude and calloused hands
This coast don’t promise easy days
But it always understands

Final Chorus 
Where the ocean meets the pines
That’s the rhythm, that’s the rhyme
Broken hearts and better times
All get healed by space and time
Sun goes down, sun comes back
Just like me, I found my way
If you’re lookin’ for a sign
It’s a southern Oregon day

Outro
Yeah…
I ain’t done, I ain’t late
Just movin’ at the speed of what lasts
Let the tide erase the tracks
I’m home… at last

lyrics:

The plow still leans by the old oak tree,
Rust on the blade, but it’s part of me.
Granddad’s hands shaped this land with pride,
Now the fields grow quiet, the screens glow bright.

From plows to pixels, the world has turned,
The fire of progress, how it burns.
But I still hear that tractor hum,
In my heart, it’ll never be done.

Mama canned peaches in a summer haze,
Now we scroll through memories in a digital maze.

Yet the smell of hay still lingers at dawn.

Now the call comes through a glowing frame.

[Chorus]
From plows to pixels, the world has turned,
The fire of progress, how it burns.

In my heart, it’ll never be done.

[Bridge]
They say the future’s bright and wide,
But I miss the rhythm of the countryside.
The click of keys, it’s a different sound,
But I long for boots on solid ground.

lyrics:
I Accept and Receive Prosperity as My Divine Right. Style: Romantic Country

Verse 1
In the stillness of my being, I already am
Owner of the abundance that Heaven has given me
I don't ask, I don't beg, I simply know:
I Am — and I have already received.

Verse 2
Prosperity is not luck, nor chance
It is the echo of truth in my grateful thought
I live as if I already am, I feel as if I already have
For what I imagine, with faith, is expressed.

Chorus
I accept and receive prosperity
As my divine right, without hesitation
I am one with the All, without need, without vanity
And the universe obeys my vision.

Verse 3
My mind is the altar, my heart is the temple
Where I whisper: “It is done,” before time
And the world bows to what I assume
For within me already dwells the Kingdom.

Bridge
There is no lack where there is full faith
There is no scarcity in serene consciousness
I am the beloved child, always provided for
My bread is already warm, my wine is already served.

Chorus (repeated)
I accept and receive prosperity
As my divine right, without hesitation
I am one with the All, without want, without vanity
And the universe obeys my vision.

Final
So be it.
So it is.
So it will be —
because I Am.

style: violini, deep brass, corrido, neomelodica, bossa nova, bagpipe, neo romantic, 3d-sound, indie grunge, dulce, saturated, violin dreamy pop
lyrics:
[Verse 1] She's ten years younger than him, her eyes holding the whole of spring. Occasionally capricious, she'll leave on a whim; the world seems to revolve around her.

She applies her lipstick too maturely, forgetting her heart is still so soft. He sees through it all at a glance, smiling as he gently takes away her unease.

[Verse 2] He's walked a longer road, understanding what it means to take things slowly. Her temper is like an afternoon thunderstorm, but he's willing to stand and wait for the rainbow to return.

It's not about who's stronger or weaker, it's just that love takes different forms. He gave her his patience; she entrusted her whole world to him.

[Chorus] Their heartbeats, ten years apart, faltered at the same second. She fussed, he laughed; one hug and everything was understood.

Ten years of youthful difference... They relied on each other, he held an umbrella for her until dawn, she learned to love gently for him.

[Scene] Others said they didn't understand, said it was too risky, they were only honest with each other. Love isn't a boundary of age, it's being willing to stay awake for each other at night.

She learned to grow up, he learned to fall in love again. In each other's eyes, they both became better people.

[Chorus] A heartbeat ten years apart, burning into the most intense flame. She was willful, he was tolerant, writing their future as the same tomorrow.

A ten-year distance, shortened little by little by holding hands. She illuminated his ordinariness, he guarded all her courage.

[Epilogue] If time could move a little faster, they would still meet, because love never asks about age, only—whether you are willing.

No tears to spill, now that you are gone
I won't say I want to see you once more
But freedom rings behind my closing door

I keep it locked…

You might go…

Between “just us”… and “what we’ve been”…

I feel it every time you’re near
But I hide it under all this fear
‘Cause if I say it and you don’t stay…
I lose you either way…

[Verse 2 – Rap / More intense]
Yeah

If I told you…

The other way…

…Do you feel it too…?

style: dreamy, indie pop, psychedelic, indie, pop, indie rock, slacker rock, male vocals, phaser, lofi , , synth solo, rock, slacker rock, shaker, sun-soaked,, Male vocals, backing vocals, violin theme
lyrics:
[Intro]  

[Verse 1]  
Clementine, you curve like a thought I shouldn’t keep  
A soft geometry I trace in glances I don’t speak  
We flirt over lunches, paper bags and time  
Salt on your fingers, joke lands out of line  

[Pre-Chorus]  
We walk when the hour pretends it’s free  
Side streets teaching us how not to be  

[Chorus]  
Oh Clementine  
You’re a metaphor I wear like a sign  
Peel back the day, leave the pith behind  
I don’t believe in forever, I believe in tonight  
Clementine  

[Solo]

[Verse 2]  
Months stack up like folders no one reads  
Distance grows kind to our buried needs  
A work trip city, hotel hums low  
Families folded into voicemail snow  

[Pre-Chorus]  
The bar light blurs what we won’t name  
Two ghosts shaking hands with the flame  

[Chorus]  
Oh Clementine  
Your orbit pulls me out of line  
We fall into shape, a soft design  
If meaning’s a rumor, let pleasure be mine  
Clementine  

[Break]

[Bridge]  
Nihilism tastes like cheap red wine  
We laugh at the edge, cross it on time  
Your body’s a question with no reply  
I answer anyway, let the reasons die  

[Verse 3]  
Morning comes thin, like a lie we keep  
Keycards forget us, promises sleep  
We button the silence, rehearse the role  
Back to the building, back to control  

[Chorus]  
Oh Clementine  
I trace your absence like a fault line  
Nothing was broken, nothing was fine  
We borrowed a moment, called it a sign  
Clementine  

[Chorus]  
Oh Clementine  
I trace your absence like a fault line  
Nothing was broken, nothing was fine  
We borrowed a moment, called it a sign  
Clementine  

[Outro]

style: reggae, uplifting, groovy, lively, playful
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Aleesa brought us so much love
She was a gift from up above.

[Verse 2]
That baby girl with tight brown curls
Second she was of our sweet girls.

[Verse 3]
We brought her home that happy day
And there we wanted her to stay.

[Verse 4]
But back for surgery she went
Where her first Christmas day was spent.

[Verse 5]
The nurses said she was a star,
They loved her little belly scar.

[Verse 6]
In first grade she went back to see
the doctors for some surgery.

[Verse 7]
That fixed her up and made her well
Into the future she did sail.

[Verse 8]
She passed her dad and grew so tall,
And fell in love with basketball.

[Verse 9]
That passion she has shared with all,
That’s why they call her car Mom Ball.

[Verse 10]
Out of the nest she flew away
To New York for a time to stay.

[Verse 11]
Then up in Utah she did find
A man who’s truly one-of-a-kind.

[Verse 12]
Matt and Aleesa - a great pair
Life with four angels they now share.

[Verse 13]
Since early in her life we knew
That always she’d be good and true.

[Verse 14]
Her fam’ly gave her love from birth
Then she became a nurse on earth.

[Verse 15]
Who heals and loves and cares for others
Serving mankind as her brothers.

[Verse 16]
She is a treasure so unique
God crowned her head with a light streak.

[Outro]
Now on this day we celebrate,
Our dear Aleesa, she is great!

Our love was short, yet it still stays
Though all the years have passed me by
My heart’s still living in that time

But why does it hurt me so
I thought time would wash away
Everything, but here I stay

But deep inside, you still glow
Each time your name drifts by
My heart stops and sighs

[Chorus – Reprise]

But why does it hurt me so
Time goes on and worlds may change
Still my heart feels just the same

I’m still the same right now

style: tragic, emotional, dynamic climaxes. Overall tone is cold and bitter, but resigned.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]

I was born pink and perfect in a pencil case
Sharp corners, clean slate, brand new face
They said I’d help you make it right
But every time I did, I got smaller inside

[Pre-Chorus]

I don’t complain, I just do my part
Turn your wrongs into paper scars

[Chorus - emotional, musical build]

I’m an eraser, baby, I fade for you
Every mistake costs me something too
You get cleaner lines, I get thinner days
I disappear so you can stay

[[Verse 2 - slightly faster and more intense]

I’ve seen names crossed out, plans revised
Letters softened, truths disguised
You press me down like I don’t feel
Like being useful makes this real

[Pre-Chorus - slow, dramatic]

I leave my dust where I used to be
Little ghosts of what you needed from me

[Chorus emotional, musical build]

I’m an eraser, baby, I fade for you
Every second chance cuts me in two
You move on, I get rubbed away
I’m proof that fixing things has a price to pay

[Bridge - sad, resigned]

One day I’m just loose in your backpack
Worn down past the point of coming back
No anger left, no will to fight
Just doing my job one last time

[Final Chorus - heroic, cold, bitter]

I’m an eraser, I knew the deal
I was born to die, not to be healed
If being useful means I’m erased
Then remember me for what I helped you save

[Outro - extremely tragic, slower]

But you don’t remember my name anymore
I was just something you used
Left behind in the bottom drawer
You don’t reach for me now
There’s nothing left I can do
I erased every doubt you had
And it erased me too

No ceremony when I’m gone
No credits, no refrain
You kept the page that mattered
And I was what you erased

style: spoken word, jazz, dynamic, indie, dramatic
lyrics:
[Female Singer]
[Verse 1]
In modems of 300 baud,
I found my lowly start,
Telecom to datacom,
the new tech writer’s art.

[Verse 2]
Siss-Op of the B.B.S.,
solutions up to me,
The modem screeches on the phone,
The Siss-Op holds the key.
And that was me.
I held the key.

[Verse 3]
From dream ware to vapor ware,
to an all-out back-bench fight,
It's up to the tech writer
to define the future flight.

[Verse 4]
At that old hi-tech startup,
Oh, the stakes were running high,
Seven teams around the clock,
And yes! I heard their cry.

[Verse 5]
Oh, the chaos runs rampant,
but we can close the loop,
With tight documentation,
we can stabilize the group.

[Verse 6]
“Just swap the vaylence,”
Engineers would pray,
Surfing chaos day and night
In a cybernetic fray
But in the end we did it.

[Chorus]
We saved the day.
With cutting edge technology,
We did.
We saved the day.

[Verse 7]
Oh, the chaos reigns in R. and D.,
we have to close the loop,
We need tight documentation,
not just alphabet soup.

[Verse 8]
Oh, it's dream ware, it's vapor ware,
changing from bit to byte
But we're not improvising,
we're documenting tight.

[Verse 9]
“Swap the vaylence” was the word,
In halls of chaos, all we heard.
But never mind, we saved the day.
With tight documentation,
We did.
We saved the day.

[Outro]
So now we document today
And tell tomorrow what to say.
Same chord progressions, just arranged
and played a whole new way.

(Deep Bass Vocal · Bright Piano Only · Key of G Minor)

Style: Raw, cinematic confessional — every pause matters.

⸻

[Intro – Bright Piano Only]

(Right hand: high G–A–Bb–D notes, slow arpeggios.

Play with breath between each phrase.)

⸻

[Verse 1 – Low, breathy tone]

If I had one more day,
I’d tell you all the things I couldn’t say.
The truth I hid when fear took hold,
The words I meant but left untold.

I’d hold your hand until the light gave way,
And whisper that I never meant to let you break.

⸻

[Pre-Chorus – Voice steady, slight lift]

The room still feels like you,
Every shadow speaks your name.

⸻

[Chorus – Gravel and depth, soft piano beneath]

If I had one more day to make it right,
I’d give forever for one more night.
I’d look into your eyes and finally say,
You were my reason — my only way.

(Hold “way” over G minor chord — let it ring into silence.)

⸻

[Verse 2 – Deep, cracked tone]

I still reach for you when the dark gets loud,
Still talk to the air like you’re around.
The mirror doesn’t lie — it just reminds,
What’s left behind in borrowed time.

If I could find you, I’d never let go,
Even if forever said no.

⸻

[Pre-Chorus 2 – Quieter, half-whispered]

I can’t change what I became,
But I’d still whisper your name.

⸻

[Bridge – Deep whisper, eyes closed]

If heaven gave me just a moment’s grace,
I’d trace my hand across your face.
No promises, no grand displays,
Just the truth I failed to say.

(High bright notes — Bb, D, G — spaced like tears hitting glass.)

⸻

[Final Chorus – Deep growl with air, let the notes tremble]

If I had one more day to see you breathe,
I’d give the world just to believe.
I’d pull you close till the night gave way,
And pray the dawn would lose its way.

One more day —
That’s all I’d need.

⸻

[Outro – Bright Piano Only]

(Right hand plays fading notes: G–Bb–D–G.
Left hand: low G held softly with pedal.
Final note rings, fading into silence.)

[Intro: Warm skank guitar and deep bassline, light shaker]

To be the shape I’m meant to be

[Chorus]
I breathe, and the world makes room!

But I bloom at my own slow rate!

style: pop, country, rock
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
It’s March 29, our Anniversary date
Dinner and a movie to help celebrate

[Verse 2]
Happy 23 years to my beautiful Bride
I can’t imagine you not by my side

[Verse 3]
The first time we met, it was quite an event
We had no idea our lives would change to this extent

[Verse 4]
The events we attended taught us both quite a lesson
God’s timing is perfect, He gave us both a blessing

[Verse 5]
The place where we met, neither was supposed to be
But God changed our schedules and said follow Me

[Verse 6]
He put us together in this fantastic place
And started us off, on this wonderful race

[Verse 7]
When we married in Galena, you were a beautiful Bride
Then both our lives changed, we were in for a ride

[Verse 8]
The chapel in Elizabeth was such a wonderful place
We walked the aisle slowly, then sang face to face

[Verse 9]
For many years we moved and our jobs did inspire
But the time finally came for us both to retire

[Verse 10]
Now I love our time together, we have a lot of fun
It’s been great and exciting, we’re always on the run

[Verse 11]
We travel the country and enjoy time at the lake
And all the sites we see as we drive from state to state

[Verse 12]
But here at home, it is the best of all
Hanging with our kids on the dock and watching them play ball

[Verse 13]
Your chair next to me is ready for you
Ready for our moments together, just us two

[Verse 14]
So sit back and relax, let the world fade away
I’m right here next to you, today and everyday

[Verse 15]
Can’t wait to hold you, right here by my side
With you forever, let’s enjoy this ride

[Verse 16]
We’ll laugh and dance, and let our spirits fly
Near or far Trish, you’re my favorite high

[Verse 17]
As I write this song for you, the thing that I’m expressing
All our thanks to God, for providing us this blessing

[Verse 18]
And I’ll never forget all the songs we sang, My Angel in the Night,
All our other favorites the songs were all just right

[Verse 19]
You are my love, yes the love of my life
And I’m so very happy to have you as my wife

[Verse 20]
I love you more now, more than ever before
And look forward to being with you more and more

[Verse 21]
So Happy Anniversary to you my true love
Let’s both offer thanks to our God up above

[Outro]
Thanks to our Father, for your love true and free
And we pray that you'll guide us through the next 23

style: Jazz Swing, Big Band, Mysterious, Male vocals
lyrics:
[Instrumental Intro]

[Verse]
There’s a streetlight hummin’ down the shadowed lane,
Where the silver tongues are whisperin’ gain and pain.
The cards are dealt, but the dealer’s blind —
Still the truth walks steady, not fallin’ behind.

[Pre-Chorus]
They sell the shine, but it fades so fast,
All that glitter’s just smoke and glass.
But I heard a trumpet sound from afar —
It said, “Be holy where the sinners are.”

[Chorus]
His light don’t close at midnight,
Grace don’t fade with time.
Though the world may spin in false delight,
I’ll keep my soul in line.

[Chorus]
I’ll wear my armor, not my pride,
In this city of fools and gold.
His light don’t close at midnight —
His fire never grows cold.
[Solo]

[Verse]
There’s a lady singin’ sweet deceit,
Dressed in charm but chained at her feet.
Her melody’s soft, her promise fine,
But her cup runs over with bitter wine.

[Pre-Chorus]
So I fix my eyes on higher ground,
Where mercy flows, where truth is found.
The narrow road ain’t paved with fame,
But it’s marked by a holy Name.

[Chorus]
His light don’t close at midnight,
Grace don’t fade with time.
Though the crowd may dance in borrowed light,
I’ll walk the narrow way

[Chorus]
I’ll guard my heart where thieves abound,
Till the trumpet’s call I hear.
His light don’t close at midnight —
The Lamb of God draws near.
[Solo]

Bridge
No silver moon, no neon glow,
Can steal the shine that saints still know.
Let Babylon roar with all her lies —
The King still reigns above the skies.
[Solo]

[Chorus]
His light don’t close at midnight,
Grace don’t fade with time.
Though the crowd may dance in borrowed light,
I’ll walk the narrow way

[Chorus]
I’ll guard my heart where thieves abound,
Till the trumpet’s call I hear.
His light don’t close at midnight —
The Lamb of God draws near.

STYLE: Dark, adult, minimal. Industrial techno + prog metal fused with tribal percussion and 50s jazz swing. Tense, awkward, human, controlled, subtle humor.

TEMPO: ~84 BPM. Constant sub + kick pulse. Verses swing, hooks snap to grid.

DRUMS: Deep techno kick, layered tribal toms, glitch trap hats in chaos, tight hats in control, micro dropouts for STOP moments.

MUSIC: Detuned upright piano with tape warmth in social sections. Fuzz bass pulses. Bassoons, low brass, horn stabs, timpani transitions. Brass sustains in control sections.

VOCALS: Close dry lead, wide gang chants, occasional vintage radio mic for adlibs and drop cues.

STRUCTURE: Internal intro → pull builds → heavy hook → social chaos → hard STOP cut → controlled groove → mirrored section → minimal resolution.

MOTIF: pull, signal shift, held tension, awkward release.

FEEL: tribal ritual meets club, chaotic but held. Symphonic drops with periodic 50s radio mic sound.

Dance-pop track blending electronic production with contemporary R&B. Song flow unfolds in standard pop-EDM structure, 116 BPM in F minor.
Verse 1 builds over sparse beats, leading to pre-chorus swell of layered harmonies & vocoder effects. Fragmented chorus/drop erupts with frantic electronic pulses and retro disco-funk grooves, repeating the hook. 
Song culminates in an anthemic outro that loops.
Instrumentation fuses EDM with nostalgic warmth of pulsating synth bass & frantic hi-hats to drive the drop, while dreamy pads & electric guitar-like synths add shimmer. Subtle piano anchors verses. Vocoder processes vocals for a robotic, echoing quality in chorus. Funky basslines & retro disco stabs inject groove.
Mezzo-soprano vocals shine with raw, soulful introspection — husky and breathy in verses, soaring to emotive belts in choruses with subtle cracks to convey heartbreak. Vocals span F3 to D♭5 & layers harmonies., male vocals

lyrics:

[Verse 1: Baritone, spoken word over sparse piano]
我是布雷克。
两点零七分，屏幕的光割开黑暗，
雨砸在窗上，像有人轻轻叩问。
风衣吸饱了水汽，咖啡凉透，
C市的街灯在积水里拉长，空得发慌。

[Verse 2: Tenor, melodic recitation, cello enters softly]
马修蜷在转椅里，
手指敲着键盘，节奏故作轻松。
鞋底的泥还没干，碎发贴着额角，
嘴角那点笑，藏不住眼里的光。

[Verse 3: Baritone, half-spoken, piano pauses on dissonant chord]
圣侣被盗——两座金童，
指纹干净得像从未被人碰过。
碎玻璃铺满展厅，
监控却在那一刻，集体失语。

[Verse 4: Tenor, slightly faster, electronic pulse faintly rises]
（spoken, tapping empty cup）
也许他们是米达斯王的私生子，
赶着回黄金宫殿过节呢？
（笑声轻，却没传到眼睛）

[Verse 5: Baritone, lower, breath held]
我想到女儿——她总在圣侣前驻足。
也转发过你的照片，说：

可现在，空气重得压住所有玩笑。

[Inst: Piano arpeggio slows, cello sustains low note, rain intensifies]

[Verse 6: Baritone and Tenor, alternating lines, overlapping slightly]
（Baritone）
偷盗集团？为何只取圣侣？
（Tenor）
内部人？可指纹为何消失？
（Baritone）
技术故障？偏偏只在那三小时？
（Tenor）
超自然？……不，不该想这个。

[Bridge: Both voices, whispered in unison, then diverge]
（whispered）
有什么不对……
（Baritone, strained）
不是幻觉……
（Tenor, faltering）
是预感……

[Verse 7: Baritone, spoken, piano stops]
屏幕闪了三下——
然后，全黑。

[Outro: Rain continues, single piano note repeats, cello fades, electronic hum dissolves into silence]
（spoken, barely audible）
只有雨……
和一座湿透的城市。

lyrics:
[instrumental intro]
(钢琴)

[Verse 1]
曾经站在  红榜砌成的神坛
仰望我的  是无数期待的眼
直到那天  我听见低语在蔓延
它问天平另一端  是否存在  另一片天
[Verse 2]
于是我走下  阶梯假装是意外 
踏入所谓  真实存在的平凡 
在及格线  画上我安全的港湾 
浑浑噩噩的十年  像部默剧  无声上演 
[Chorus]
天赋它弃我而去  如流沙散 
我守着废墟  把昨天悼念 
酸苦辣都尝遍  唯独没有甜 
在清醒中  我把自己流放边关 
[Chorus]
这十年之蜕  痛彻心扉 
撕掉标签  看清我是谁 
告别那场  自导自演的坠毁 
与平凡的自己  干杯  致敬这狼狈 
敬我曾头也不回！ 
[Interlude]
(钢琴)

[Verse 3]
也曾在招聘会  像沙丁鱼搁浅 
简历苍白如纸  写满我的无言 
挤在格子间  把梦想碾成碎片 
看霓虹点亮黑夜  照不亮我  内心的深渊 
[Chorus]
直到某个寒冬  便利店窗边 
我看见倒影里  陌生憔悴的脸 
那虚无的尽头  传来一声响鞭 
问我还想不想  找回失落的碎片 
[Chorus]
这十年之蜕  痛彻心扉 
撕掉标签  看清我是谁 
告别那场  自导自演的坠毁 
与平凡的自己  干杯  致敬这狼狈 
敬我曾头也不回！ 
[Bridge]
堕落与智慧  都是我  一体两面 
这场漫长战争  是自我的加冕 
不再问对错  不再分辨鬼与神 
我就是我  废墟里  重生的普通人 
[Chorus]
这十年之蜕  落子无悔！ 
拥抱残缺  完整的才是美 
未来如旷野  风向由我心支配 
与真实的自己  干杯  致敬所有泪 
敬我 终将高飞！
[Outro]
(钢琴)

[End]

style: Classical,Calm,Erhu,male singer
lyrics:
在时光长河静静流淌的角落
有两双眼睛 闪烁着爱的火
那是父母 用一生把我雕琢
岁月在他们脸上 刻下了斑驳

小时候 我在他们怀里安卧
听着温暖的歌谣 做着甜的梦
他们为我挡下 所有的风波
把我护在 这小小的安乐窝

当我背起行囊 勇敢去漂泊
他们的牵挂 像风筝的线索
电话里的叮嘱 满是关切的热
每一句话语 都让我心热

父亲的背 曾经是那么宽阔
扛起了家庭 扛起了生活的负荷
如今有些弯曲 却依然是依托
我多想 为他分担这岁月的磨

母亲的手 总是那么的柔和
为我缝补着 生活里的褶皱
那掌心的茧 是爱的成就
我好想 把她的辛苦都带走

感恩父母情 像一首永恒的歌
旋律里都是 他们无私的付出
感恩父母情 像夜空中的星河
照亮我前行 每一步的路

还记得 那些一起的欢乐时刻
一家人围坐 分享着生活的喜乐
父母的笑容 是最美的花朵
绽放在我 生命的每个角落

成长的路上 有过太多的波折
是他们的鼓励 让我重新振作
在我迷茫时 为我点亮灯火
指引我 走向光明的那方坡

感恩父母情 像一杯醇厚的酒
越品越香浓 醉了我的心窝
感恩父母情 像春天的花朵
芬芳了我 整个生命的轮廓

我知道 他们的爱不会有尽头
就像那青山 永远不会变瘦
我愿用一生 去把这份爱守
让他们的晚年 不再有忧愁

在未来的日子 我会紧紧牵着
他们的手 陪他们慢慢的走
把所有的爱 都为他们倾注
让感恩的花 永远不会凋落

因为有他们 我才如此的富有
拥有这世上 最珍贵的所有
感恩父母情 永在我心中留
这份深情 直到天长地久

lyrics:
我五岁的时候
看着别人吃冰棒流口水
五分钱一根
我没钱
那天太阳很烈
风也燥
连心都被晒得发烫

后来
我从二哥口袋里
偷了五块钱
手在抖
心在跳
冰棒在嘴里化开
甜得发苦
像被良心咬了一口

上初一那年
家离学校有一小时的路
看着同学骑车经过
阳光在他们笑里闪光
我低着头
脚下的灰尘
都在嘲笑我穷

十四岁那年
我在工地打工
门口停着一辆破旧的单车
已经落满灰尘
我看了它三天
终于狠下心
骑回乡下
三小时的风
在耳边骂我
也在哭我

后来我再也没偷过
我懂了
人不是生来坏的
是生活逼着你
去跨过那条不该过的线

有人被环境吞没
有人被良心救回
我庆幸
那天风声里
我听见自己的心在喊
别忘了你是谁

人性不是非黑即白
善恶之间
总有一盏灯
照亮回家的路
